description.value: Eagle Bay Mercantile is a family-owned convenience and Rural Agency Liquor store that has served the Shuswap community since 2016, located 19km down Eagle Bay Road from Trans-Canada Highway 1. The store stocks groceries, liquor, tobacco, and lottery tickets, and offers propane refills, making it a practical all-in-one resupply stop on an otherwise remote rural corridor. It is locally celebrated as the home of 'the coldest beer in the Shuswap.'

address.value: 4562 Eagle Bay Road, Eagle Bay, BC
